unsaved.summary_full:
HEADLINE: Tracker CSV export added at /export.csv; month filter still to do
Goal: Let people download the tracker as a spreadsheet.
Done: Added /export.csv (tracker/export.py) with a header row; dates in ISO format.
Decisions: Streamed the rows (StreamingHttpResponse) because a 10,000-row project timed out when built in memory.
Gotchas: Excel reads 2026-03-04 as a date only with the UTF-8 BOM; written in export.py line 12.
Result: Works for all projects; checked by downloading the file and opening it in Numbers.
Files & PRs: tracker/export.py, tracker/urls.py; no PR yet.
Open: No filter by month; very large projects not tried.
Next: Add ?month=YYYY-MM and test with a project of 10,000 rows.

Decided: round per line, not per order, because the tax office wants line totals
Gotchas: the 500 only shows with two coupons on one order
Open: tax rounding on stacked coupons
Next: fix round_total() in shop/tax.py, then re-run the coupon tests
